facts.fact: Nikolas 的神化：双目如夏日灼烧、ribbons of molten veins cascading over his skin、羽发皆染黎明淡金、头部冠以矛形光纹；Rian 掷盾先入——「Trapping him.」；「Nikolas 拔矛遁空——刀口黑血落地 smoking and hissed」；「Solara, growing colder——他的血渐热（承上章吞日）」
facts.anchor: ribbons of molten veins cascading over his skin.

facts.fact: 兄弟手语：Phos 抬爪按新伤「HOW DOES MY THIRD CHILD TASTE?」——Nikolas 不答、转向 Rian——「even through the eye-watering brilliance Rian recognized that look」——拽右耳「I'm all right.」——「They may as well have been in the training grounds of Cyr villa, facing their father two to one.」；兄弟合击（一攻翅一攻胸——对准「the older, seeping wound」）；「Weaken the throne, then weaken the body.」——Rian 看出王座裂的「how they could break」

兄弟合璧：Phos 召「column 长的 solar energy 之刃」——兄弟换位（「第三套动作」——与父亲训练时同款）；「Like a meteor hurtling to earth, Nikolas shoved the spear into the weeping, blackened wound on Phos's chest.」——盾落、神嚎——「The injury Nyx had dealt him, the one that should have been fatal, had been ripped open anew. Black blood streaked with golden rivers spilled down his torso」；「YOU WILL NOT BE RID OF ME SO EASILY. YOU WILL NEVER BE RID OF ME.」
facts.anchor: Weaken the throne, then weaken the body.

facts.fact: Rian 的决断：胸骨内「familiar yank」——Phos 欲跳体——「This feeling—it had visited him before, in the throes of fever. Back when prayers had been said over his failing body so many times that Phos had had no choice but to answer. No.」——他掷枪未及——Taesia 冰刃抵喉「Go ahead. Try it. See how long you last.」；Nikolas 狂扑被 Julian/Fin 拦下「Just wait.」；Rian「It's all right.」（拽耳）——Ulshära 同样被 Dante 刃抵（「resignation. Acceptance.」）——「If Phos were to make the jump to any of them, no one would risk his continued existence.」「He wouldn't mind if it was Taesia who ended him after all. He knew she would make it quick.」

Rian 一枪定局：Phos 痉挛冒汽、王座呻吟「YOU THINK THIS IS MY END? OH, MY CHILDREN, I AM NOT DONE WITH YOU YET.」——「But he was not done fighting.」——举手（「他一向在手里看见父亲：同樣粗砺的指节、同樣宽的指尖——手势近乎恳求，像准备迎接神归来」）——lightspeed sigil 闪现、枪入掌、扣扳机——「弹寻溃烂重开的伤口——胸口裂成 spread 的 trench，敞开神之内里的疯狂。Cloying honey and acrid salt. Chewed-up stars among primordial skies. A thousand extinction events in a single drop of ichor.」；「这具不可能的身体本该数百年前就死——在维持它活到如今的巨大张力下开始 warp and collapse——facing its own gravity like a sun about to explode.」
facts.anchor: A thousand extinction events in a single drop of ichor.

facts.fact: 爆炸与确认：Taesia 拖他奔逃、以体覆他（丁香气味）——「The remaining two suns had become twenty, had become a hundred, searing the entire realm. The ground heaved as buildings crashed and the city wall collapsed. The desert screamed. Rian screamed with it.」；「Anyone home?」「Just me.」——「The silence of a world without its god. Overhead, the First and Second Suns began to drift apart, returning to their rightful places.」；Nikolas「I don't sense him at all.」（翼收、熔脉缩、尖冠消失）；Ulshära 跪地「Gone. His body is no more.」；Rian 望自己的手「In that moment, it didn't matter that he had his father's hands. He had used them to shape a different future. He had used them to tear himself free.」

Risha 的清单：Samhara 里已无 Solarian 魂（全数用于攻盾与 glyph）——amalgam 倒成一堆「mangled dune of flesh covered in sightless eyes」；Jas「Once, you shunned the idea of using souls this way.」——她「I shunned a lot of things, once. + Saya 之言『You can always change who you want to become.』I need to become someone who wins wars. Today, it's Phos. Tomorrow, it's Thana.」；Angelica 给 Cosima 疗伤「I didn't want her to get hurt.」——Cosima 已被 Bones 治好；Angelica 摸平的额头「She just doesn't understand yet. I don't have to be afraid of Deia anymore. With this power, I can make Deia afraid of me.」——「The death of one god had nearly shattered them like the paving stones; every advantage was a gift they could not overlook.」；Valentin 之评「She was not yet done with Mortri. Her burden of vengeance had not yet lifted. Phos today, and Thana tomorrow. And after that, maybe her stopped heart could beat again.」

章末揭底：Ulshära 不放 Taesia（Sunslayer 终于可罚——「What better way to restore morale?」）；Rian 嘶哑问「Why was only Ulshära and I threatened when Phos was preparing to make one of us his vessel? Why didn't he try to possess Nik? Or merge with the part of the fulcrum that's in the spear?」——Risha 与 Taesia 交换眼神、引第三十二章原话「The physical component is in the throne. The spiritual one… It might be in the Sunbringer Spear. It might not.」——「Because he couldn't. Phos didn't put his fulcrum in the spear.」——Nikolas 之眼「pinched with disquiet. With bleak understanding.」「The feathers. The wings. The consumption of a sun's remains.」——astralam 在她余光中静观——「In her peripheral vision, the astralam ghost watched her quietly. Her grip tightened on Starfell. On the one thing Nyx could not control.」「Phos put his fulcrum into Nik.」
facts.anchor: Phos put his fulcrum into Nik.
